column3: The optional provider features of VISION 2026-09-22. localstores
installs inventoryd and the declaration file that declares it, and
is on by default because it only reads. modelhost installs
modelhostd only and is off by default; openabstractions models

mcpgateway installs the stdio MCP server and is off by default.

column1: > A row whose source has no published commit yet is still built by a --src build
> and still left out of a --bin one. sources.tsv says which sources those are.
> A row the --bin route cannot fill must be gated in abstraction.wxs, because a
> gate is what turns a missing file into a smaller package instead of a red
> build. openabstractions.exe and openabstractionsw.exe are the console and
> windowless links of the one serve source, and both rows are required: the
> windowless image is what the service template, the Startup shortcut and the
> jobdw, dl, jobctl and the Python file-store packages leave the payload in
> over_curl.hpp has a declared abstraction-download-over-curl repository rule,
> but no public refs were present at the 2026-09-12 check. Until a public commit
> is verified, its optional source stays UNRESOLVED.
> The Panel embeds monitor/panel.manifest as a Windows resource instead of
> shipping it as a side-by-side file: monitor/panel.rc names it RT_MANIFEST id
> built by `go run ./monitor/icon/gen -syso`) carry the compiled result into
> every `go build` of this package, --bin and --src alike, with no payload row
> of its own to drop. The manifest's Common-Controls dependency still names
> processorArchitecture="amd64"; on the arm64 build this is a known mismatch
> that the OS resolves by falling back to unthemed controls for that
> architecture only, not by losing the manifest or the Panel feature.
